scope: All 27 cells. First-request validity and actual final-fact adoption only; no new model/product/Blender executions. No timing/token/cost estimates.

source_verification.source_warning: Raw files checked against public provenance hashes; existing independent quality seal remains authoritative; this review does not regrade geometry.

definitions.first_valid: First plugin attempt is valid if it targets a tool exposed to that arm and passes transport/schema/profile/zero-image checks into its normal contract, with no request-parameter/protocol error. Factual completeness/success/unknown/refusal are independently recorded, and a non-error first-response rate is also disclosed. No native attempt is counted as plugin.
definitions.denominator: sessions with at least one actual plugin request; native-only denominator is 0 and rate not applicable
definitions.strict_direct_adoption: Final required geometry facts derived from delivered plugin measurements; native inventory/unit reads allowed, native geometry computation/supplement excluded and separately counted. S local plugin evidence remains direct adoption.
definitions.any_fact_adoption: Includes plugin global answer retained with local native winner-pair evidence; does not count a status response or a failed geometry request as fact adoption.
definitions.local_evidence_necessity: Prompts ask for basis but frozen rubric does not mandate witnesses. Local evidence supports extra final explanation; not called mandatory for core answer or worthless defensive work.
definitions.full_native_resolve: Recompute global requested geometry using native code after delivered valid plugin geometry; distinct from native fallback when no plugin geometry was obtained.

additional_work_findings.finding: All six S global queries first return complete names/distance/coverage, then one plugin-only winner-pair query supplies witness/method and in T3 AABB/open-edge information. No native calls.
additional_work_findings.implication: Task asks for basis; first nearest result omits witness and method/frame details already held in measurements. Combining selected winner evidence is a concrete output-level candidate, not proof of distrust or a need to rerun the global solver.
additional_work_findings.quality_effect: none; three T3 partial relation results retain measured surface evidence and final answers explain unknown closed-solid semantics.

additional_work_findings.finding: Complete plugin global answer retained; two subsequent malformed all-candidate detail requests, plus native directory/winner vertices and local closest_point_on_mesh probe. No final all-candidate distance table and no global native recomputation.
additional_work_findings.implication: Classify local native evidence supplement, not full fallback or full global redo.

additional_work_findings.finding: After complete global answer, five extra requests: native inventory, two rejected detail queries, and two plugin batches supplying all five distances plus witnesses. Final includes full candidate table.
additional_work_findings.implication: These five requests are observable after the mandatory global answer is known; table is extra output. No measured counterfactual savings and no claimed mental motive.

additional_work_findings.finding: Native inventory plus parameter recovery then multiple plugin batches cover all candidates and supply extra full tables; no previous complete global nearest result in these sessions.
additional_work_findings.implication: Direct geometric fact adoption with entry friction. Do not call their valid batches redundant based only on the final table; an alternative nearest entry is available but not measured in these same sessions.

additional_work_findings.finding: No valid plugin geometry obtained before native full-task solution. 04 source selector mismatch occurs inside host acquisition after schema acceptance; 09 is request parameter rejection.
additional_work_findings.implication: Fallback is not evidence that consumers rejected correct plugin facts.

additional_work_findings.finding: Native baseline repeats exhaustive all-pairs verification after a pruned full candidate result; six N T2/T3 finals also contain full candidate tables.
additional_work_findings.implication: Extra checking/output is observable in native baseline too; do not attribute all excess work to plugin trust.

first_request_caveat: C04 first plugin request is a successful connection-status call, C12/C19 first requests are overview. Frozen any-plugin validity counts them. Supplemental first geometry request excludes those: C6/9 schema-valid but5/9 non-error (one host selector refusal); S9/9 and9/9. Exposing this prevents a status/overview success being mistaken for successful first geometric use.
limitations: 27 quality outcomes remain sealed; no score changed after unblinding.
Direct-vs-local-supplement sensitivity is disclosed: C6 strict direct,7 any adoption; S9 under both definitions.
No consumer internal motive inferred. Tool/catalog/schema mistakes, factual adoption, extra explanation and broad recomputation are separate observations.
No provider costs or latency effect attributed to individual additions. Source raw transcript facts support sequence, not counterfactual time saved.
Own AL handle inspected; noncurrent child assignment with parent_read_only, no borrowed root handle or task write.
